findings.summary: When the query errors, both the EmptyState and (if cached) the data block can render together because the data block is gated only on d, not on !q.isError.
findings.fix: Gate the data block on success only, e.g. {d && !q.isError ? ... : null}, so the error EmptyState is shown alone rather than alongside cached data.

findings.summary: The two section headings use bespoke <h2 className="font-black"> with no size/spacing token, inconsistent with sibling section headers that pair a heading with a muted subtitle.
findings.fix: Standardize the card section headers (reuse the OrganizationPage pattern: a header row with <h2 className="font-black"> plus an optional muted subtitle) for visual consistency across management pages.

findings.summary: Error badges pass e.level directly to StatusBadge; a level such as 'fatal' is not in the map and falls back to a neutral badge showing the raw English key, breaking Arabic localization and color semantics.
findings.fix: Add missing level keys (e.g. 'fatal') to the StatusBadge map in src/ui/StatusBadge.tsx with tone 'danger', or normalize e.level to a known key before passing it.

findings.summary: Metric label 'آخر Backup' mixes an English word into Arabic UI text where an Arabic term is available, unlike other fully-Arabic metric labels.
findings.fix: Use an Arabic label such as 'آخر نسخة احتياطية' for the backup MetricCard to match the surrounding Arabic labels.

findings.summary: The fatalErrors/unresolvedErrors metric cards give no visual severity emphasis (e.g. danger accent), so critical counts read visually identical to neutral zero counts.
findings.fix: Pass a danger-toned hint or trend to the fatalErrors/unresolvedErrors MetricCards when count > 0 so severity is not conveyed by the number alone.

findings.summary: The flags rollout line 'نسبة الإطلاق: {rolloutPercent}%' is plain muted text with no visual meter, a missed polish opportunity given the available surface/border tokens.
findings.fix: Optionally render a token-based progress meter (bg-[var(--surface-subtle)] track with a --brand-primary fill) for rolloutPercent to make the value scannable.
